title: janus-design: joint amino-acid and codon optimisation for de novo designed proteins
description: Software for joint optimisation over amino-acid and coding sequence. Constructs a lattice whose branches at each position are the codons of every residue within a log-probability budget of the inverse-folding marginal, and extracts the k highest-scoring paths exactly under a decomposable objective spanning fold compatibility, codon adaptation, codon-pair bias and GC content. Terms that do not decompose over lattice nodes, including mRNA folding and protein-level liabilities, are optimised in a rescoring tier. Includes host policy files for Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) and HEK293, the analysis scripts used in the accompanying paper, and the test suite.
